landing.heroSubtitle: Get your devices fixed by certified technicians. Fast, reliable, and affordable repair services for all your tech needs.
landing.ctaBody: Submit your repair request now and our team will get back to you within 24 hours.

submit.title: Submit Repair Request
submit.body: Fill out the form with your device details and upload images.

review.title: Technician Review
review.body: Our experts review your request and diagnose the issue.

estimate.title: Receive Price Estimate
estimate.body: Get a transparent cost estimate and repair timeline.

send.title: Send Device
send.body: Choose to bring it to our store or request courier pickup.

repaired.title: Device Repaired
repaired.body: We repair your device and notify you when it's ready.

form.title: Submit Repair Request
form.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
form.profileIncomplete: Please complete your profile (email and phone number) before requesting a repair — we use it to contact you about your device.
form.profileReady: Your contact details are ready. We'll reach you at the email and phone below.
form.emailMissing: Add an email in your profile
form.phoneMissing: Add a phone number in your profile
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Please describe the issue you're experiencing in detail…
form.uploadHint: Upload up to 4 images showing the issue (Optional)
form.uploadCta: Click to upload or drag and drop
form.subtitle: Tell us about your device, then choose how to get it to us.
form.deliveryHint: Choose how to get your device to us — this is required to submit your request.
form.pickDelivery: Please choose how to get your device to us.
form.uploadHintRequired: Add at least 1 photo of the issue (up to 4) — we price the repair from what they show.
form.imagesRequired: Add at least one photo of the problem.
form.next1: You get an instant preliminary estimate.
form.next3: We send you the final price to accept or decline.

success.title: Repair Request Submitted
success.body: Our technicians will review your request shortly. You'll receive an email confirmation at
success.estimatePendingBody: Analysing your photos and description. This usually takes a few seconds.
success.estimateDisclaimer: Generated automatically from your photos and description as a rough guide. Our technicians will inspect your device and send you the final price before any repair starts.
success.estimateUnavailableBody: We couldn't prepare a preliminary price for this one. Our technicians will review your device and send you a full quote — nothing is delayed.

list.title: My Repairs
list.emptyBody: When you request a repair it'll appear here so you can track its progress.

card.chooseDelivery: Choose how to get your device to us
card.payCourier: Pay the courier fee to book your pickup
card.chooseReturn: Choose how to get your device back
card.payReturn: Pay the courier fee for the return

detail.deliveryChangeHint: You can change this until your device reaches our team.
detail.deliveryChangedNote: Changed from {{previous}} — our team has been notified.
detail.switchRefundNote: You've already paid the courier fee. Switch to a store drop-off and our team will refund it — it isn't returned automatically.
detail.saveFailed: Couldn't save your choice. Please try again.
detail.actionFailed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
detail.reviewing: Our team is currently reviewing your request — we've emailed you a confirmation. Next, choose how to get your device to us.
detail.bringToStoreBody: Bring your device to one of our store locations.
detail.noStores: No stores available in your region yet.
detail.courierPickupBody: We'll send a courier to collect your device (fee applies).
detail.courierPaymentPendingBody: Pay the courier pickup fee to schedule the collection of your device — or choose to bring it to a store below instead.
detail.returnPaymentPendingBody: Pay the courier fee to have your device delivered back to you — or collect it from the store for free instead.
detail.awaitingCourier: A courier will collect your device and deliver it to our store. We'll update this page once it arrives.
detail.awaitingDropoff: Please drop your device at {{store}}. We'll start the review as soon as we receive it.
detail.underReview: We've received your device and our technicians are diagnosing the issue. You'll get a price estimate shortly.
detail.inRepair: You've accepted the estimate and our team has started the repair. We'll let you know as soon as it's ready.
detail.completed: Your repair is complete! Thanks for choosing Buyology.
detail.returnBody: You've declined the estimate. Choose how you'd like to receive your device back.
detail.returnCourierChosen: A courier will deliver your device back to you.
detail.returnPickupChosen: You can collect your device from the store.
